title: cyperus globosus var. humifusus
intro: Cyperus globosus var. humifusus, commonly known as the Swamp Sedge, is a type of plant that belongs to the sedge family (Cyperaceae). The Swamp Sedge has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of fever, wounds, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity against a range of pathogens. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, such as limonene and beta-pinene, which have been identified in various studies.
